## About
Gold Seal Painting is Robert Seal's painting business, based on Lambert St in Leander. He handles interior and exterior custom painting for homes around the Austin area, and he's usually the one doing the work himself.
Customers rate Gold Seal Painting 5 stars on Google from 24 reviews. One reviewer noted he kept his work area clean and organized, and another said he went back over spots for touch up. As one customer put it, he's a local business owner, not a big brand franchise.
If you have a room, a house, or an old shed that needs fresh paint, give Robert a call and he'll come take a look.

## Services
- Interior and exterior painting: Ceilings, walls and trim inside, and trim and other exterior work outside. One reviewer said Robert went back over spots for touch up.
- Kitchen cabinets: Give your kitchen cabinets a new color. One customer had theirs done in a much lighter shade.
- Doors, shutters and barn shed: One customer had doors, shutters and a large barn shed painted, and said the old shed now looks new.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Call and Robert will set up a free estimate for your project.

Q: What area do you serve?
A: Gold Seal Painting is based in Leander and has served the Austin area for over 18 years.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Closed Sunday.

Robert was a pleasure to have around the house. He was always friendly, professional, and kept his work area clean and organized throughout the project. I’m very particular about details, and he was always patient with my requests and happy to make sure everything was done the way I wanted.
